## Appearance

Henry Warren is described as kind of undersized and delicate. This frail physical stature was already present when he first came to live with the family around the age of twelve.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XXIX. A WEIRD TALE P9](../source/v05-c29.md#nw-v05-c29-p0009)_

## History

Henry Warren was taken in by his aunt and uncle at twelve years old after his mother died. He was severely mistreated by them, enduring beatings and starvation that left him suffering from epileptic fits and growing up simple-minded. After his death, a ghost story spread among the local children claiming that his spirit haunted the nearby [Bailey](../codex/places.md#bailey) garden, which frightened them enough to avoid the area at night.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XXIV. A CHARITABLE IMPULSE P1](../source/v05-c24.md#nw-v05-c24-p0001), [v5 CHAPTER XXIV. A CHARITABLE IMPULSE P4](../source/v05-c24.md#nw-v05-c24-p0004), [v5 CHAPTER XXIV.
